notes: Real simultaneous common item dialogs are verified through the SDK/controller and UIA worker, not an MCP dual-dialog test.
Immediate path readback mismatch and slow polling responses use a synthetic provider process.

Actual PID/HWND reuse remains unverified. Native backends for macOS/Linux, IME, file/data drag-and-drop and a general release acceptance platform remain outside the implemented scope.
